name: Card
label: Card
description: A titled preview tile for index grids, with a case-study variant carrying a cover, company logo and dek.

props.name: title
props.description:
Card title displayed below the preview.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Card does not expose.

props.name: children
props.description: Preview content rendered inside the card (default variant only)

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation href — renders the card as an <a> tag

props.name: cover
props.description:
Cover content rendered in place of the image — for a cover that is drawn
rather than photographed (an SVG, a chart, a live preview). Takes
precedence over `coverSrc`, and fills the same fixed-ratio slot.

props.name: companyLogo
props.description: Path to the company logo shown in the eyebrow

props.name: companyName
props.description: Company name shown in the eyebrow

props.name: dek
props.description: Subtitle / dek line below the title

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Render as a disabled placeholder (no href, dimmed, not interactive)

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the link renders with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so it
navigates through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.
